content: अभिमन् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (<ab>P.</ab> <ab>epic.</ab>) .²1 To wish or desire, long for, covet, like; न त्वेवं ज्यायसीं वृत्तिमभिमन्येत कर्हिचित् <ls>Ms. 10. 95</ls>; see अभिमत below. .²2 To assent to, approve of, allow, admit; give a grant (to any one, <ab>dat.</ab>). .²3 To think, fancy, imagine, consider, believe, regard; तामार्यामसावन्यथाऽभ्यमन्यत <ls>Dk. 164</ls>; <ls>Bk. 5. 71</ls>; <ls>U. 5</ls>. .²4 To injure, threaten (<ab>Ved.</ab>) .²5 (€8 <ab>Ā.</ab>) To think of self.
